idea-plugin.name: SeqLens
idea-plugin.description:
SeqLens turns Java code into interactive sequence diagrams — together with the database tables and external APIs the code touches.

Right-click inside a Java method and choose SeqLens: Generate Sequence Diagram. Every arrow, participant and SQL note is clickable and jumps to the source.

Sequence diagrams

  • Control flow fragments: alt, opt, loop (including stream lambdas) and try / catch
  • Expands the single production implementation of an interface (test fakes ignored, @Primary respected)
  • throw drawn as a red dashed arrow back to the caller

Database tables

  • Spring Data repositories: derived queries, built-in CRUD, @Query (JPQL / native), @NamedQuery
  • @DynamicRepository / @DynamicQuery with [ … ] optional fragments
  • JPA EntityManager, Hibernate Session, JdbcTemplate, NamedParameterJdbcTemplate, JdbcClient
  • JPQL entity names mapped to table names (@Table → @Entity(name) → snake_case), including joins

External APIs

  • RestTemplate, RestClient, WebClient, @HttpExchange interfaces and OpenFeign @FeignClient
  • Arrows labeled like GET /orders/{id}; service names from URL hosts, @Value("${...}") or Feign client names

Focus and export

  • Stop list to draw calls without expanding them; MapStruct mappers shown without their generated implementation
  • Warning when the maximum depth hides part of the flow, with one-click "regenerate deeper"
  • Resources panel listing external APIs, tables and classes / methods used by the flow
  • Copy or export as PNG, SVG, PlantUML, Mermaid or a Markdown resource list

action.description: Generate a sequence diagram for the selected Java method
